clue.text: Artificial part where call girl's the little sister?

taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: Read 'call girl's the little sister' as PRO'S THE SIS and close the gaps.
explanation.definitionFit: A prosthesis is a manufactured replacement for a missing limb or other body part.

clue.text: Dodge south despite going west

clue.text: Replace shag?

clue.text: Schedule back-breaking crash at movie's finale

clue.text: Spreading operations during an attack from below

clue.text: Nothing having external forward thrust is idle

clue.text: Said to go down in unison

clue.text: Precipitation from big guns having gone overboard?

explanation.definitionFit: Rainwater is water that falls from the sky as precipitation.

clue.text: Key line that follows 10/5

clue.text: Officer protected by total cover

clue.text: Deadly stuff when bum's not quite pleasant

clue.text: Observation about split lip being flatter

clue.text: Flexible soldiers rubbish no one in retreat for making up deficiencies

clue.text: Accumulated knowledge covering fall of French region

clue.text: Bond will be there in seconds with this
